question: A newcomer wants to buy a cheaper child car seat outside Canada for use in Canada. What Canadian requirements should they verify before purchasing?
generated_answer:
You must verify that the car seat model you intend to buy meets the requirements of the Motor Vehicle Safety Act and its regulations before purchasing. Child car seats that do not meet these requirements cannot legally be imported or used in Canada, and will be refused entry if not accompanied by the child when entering Canada.

Some child car seats cannot be used in Canada or imported into the country. They include:

models designed to be rear-facing

models that are not equipped with a harness system

models that are not equipped with a tether strap system

models that are designed for children who weigh 40 lb (18 kg) or more and are not equipped with a harness system

models that are designed for children who weigh 40 lb (18 kg) or more and are not equipped with a tether strap system

The label affixed to the car seat must include model name, model number, date of manufacture and the words "This child restraint system conforms to all applicable Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards" and "Important Safety Information" in English and French. In addition, the car seat must have a National Safety Mark affixed to it. The National Safety Mark indicates that the product has been certified as meeting the minimum safety requirements of the Motor Vehicle Safety Act and its regulations. The National Safety Mark consists of a maple leaf with a crown on top of it. If your child car seat does not meet these requirements, it will be refused entry into Canada and will have to be sent back to its country of origin or destroyed. For more information about child car seats, please refer to the following website: http://www.tc.gc.ca/eng/roadsafety/tp_13402_10203_10603_10903/child-seats-eng.html. You may also contact the Road Safety and Vehicle Regulations Directorate by email at RVSR-ONSR@tc.gc.ca or by phone at 1-800-333-0371 (toll-free in Canada) or 613-998-8616 (outside of Canada).
